items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: And my uncle played saxophone in that band too so I sort of had — they were all my heroes, all those people.

ctx.x: And his band, was it a big band or was it a combo?
No it was three saxes, just three saxes, a trombone and three trumpets and three rhythm. And my uncle played saxophone in that band too so I sort of had — they were all my heroes, all those people.
So the violin didn’t last too long?
